Front-matter titles still live in Word text boxes the importer drops, so they are re-inserted here.

_note_terms: Temu 1-3 = Term 1-3 banners (a one-cell table in the manuscript): each gets a term page, as in the sibling TG.
_note_setHeading: The revised manuscript puts each unit on its own line (GAWO LOYAMBA, GAWO LA CIWILI …), which the word list's 'Gawo' finds as units. The four skill strands (GAWO LA KUWELENGA / MAU / MVETSO / KULEMBA) also open with GAWO and were read as units too, so they go back to plain headings like the first strand (KUMVETSELA NDI KULANKHULA). The Mutu topic lines become sub-topics (h2) so the contents lists them; four typed in capitals (KULEMBA, MAU, MVEKELO) take the title case of their other copies. Three headings glue the topic and sub-topic on one line (Mutu: Kuwelenga Mwaluso / Mutu Waung'ono: Kuwelenga Mokweza): split back into two.

_note_authors: The six names listed under ALEMBI on the imprint page; the manuscript cover itself carries no byline.
_note_asPara: Signature lines that the importer read as bold headings: as headings they were kept with the next section title and moved onto its page.
_note_justify: MAU OYAMBA follows the imprint directly and its title is in a text box, so the importer centred its paragraphs with the imprint; the manuscript justifies them.
_note_tight: Each of the four front-matter sections spilled two or three lines (or just its signature) onto a second page; tighter paragraph gaps keep each on one page where it fits.
_note_cover: Cover hero chosen by the user 2026-11-17: the picture on page 8 (Nchito 1: Kutsegula ndi kutseka buku, a girl opening her Cinyanja book; manuscript media image9.png), using its Real-ESRGAN copy (1725 px, about 350 DPI on the cover card). It replaces the costume photo chosen in October. Cropped (no retouching) to the cover card shape 1.564:1 from the top edge down, so her head and the book stay whole; only desk at the bottom is lost. Committed next to the sidecar like the TG cover.
_note_removeImages: image5 is the same costume photo as image4 (squashed and cropped), placed straight after it under Zocita: the page printed one photograph twice and pushed the Zocita instruction onto the next page.
_note_wordFix: Spelling, to the book's own majority form: Noriana Muneka (the Permanent Secretary, as in the sibling TG and the other ZEPH books; the LB typed Noliana); yosiyana-qwsiyana -> yosiyana-siyana; Zolembadwa -> Zolembedwa (7 to 1); Zolembala -> Zolembela (3 to 1). Mvekelo ia Malembo -> la (the book's only "ia"). anamuyamiki;a -> anamuyamikila (a semicolon typed for l). 18 Nov full read: aKuwelenga -> akuwelenga (find-and-replace slip); and to the book's c-spelling, one form per word: chifukwa -> cifukwa (20 to 3), chitseko -> citseko, cha -> ca (33 to 1), zochita -> zocita (201 to 1), masewelo -> masewela (46 to 1), kutengapo -> kutengako (4 to 1). Words that contain a hyphen of their own (reduplication: zosiyana-siyana, mobweleza-bweleza, eni-eni; syllable splits: bu-ku) take a word joiner after the hyphen, so with hyphenation off they never break at a line end either.
_note_imprint: Copyright page laid out as the house model (Silozi G4 LB; HOUSE-STYLE imprint): rights line, authors, editor, illustrator, layout, publisher + address, ISBN with dots, printer; every label bold on its own line with the name plain below. The cover/layout credit is Teddy Ng`ambi (house rule for every book since 16 Nov 2026) under the manuscript's own Cinyanja label. ALEMBI (Authors) is also the word list's Authors-section title, so the label and the illustrator credit "Alembi" are marked noPromote to stay on the copyright page.

_note_imprintSpacing: At the Grade 1 type size the copyright page ran four lines onto a second page; tighter line and group spacing (as on the Chitonga G1 LB) keeps it on one.
_note_pageBreak: At the Grade 1 type size MAU OYAMBA and MAU OTSOGOLELA run two lines plus the signature past one page even with tight gaps; the closing paragraph goes over with the signature instead, so the second page is not a two-line stub. Two end-of-unit stories (Mwana Wocita Sewelo; Mwana wosamala) start a fresh page so their title is not left at a page foot with the story picture overleaf. Unit 8's end-of-unit test opens a fresh page, so it is not split with two lines overleaf before Unit 9.

_note_dropBreaks: Each lesson (Mutu) opens a fresh page; where the lesson before ran only a few lines onto a page (under 30% full), that page break is dropped so the next lesson follows on the same page (Chitonga G1 TG method).
_note_sticky: The Luso Lapadela skill line under each topic stack stays with the activity heading below it, so a stack is never stranded at a page foot.

_note_image31: image31 is one strip of three scenes (boy reading / mother cooking / father going to the field) that the manuscript crops three ways, one scene per sentence (Mwana akuwelenga buku p49, Amai akuphika nsima, Atate akupita ku munda). _note_imageSizes: Pictures sized down so a lesson moves up onto the part-empty page before it (user, 18 Nov: "work on the image to move up"): image33 (Chisomo story) 300 px, image54 (letter blocks) 420 px, image53 380 px, image128 470 px. 18 Nov check (user: look for any problem): image25 (shapes chart) 72 mm tall so it sits under its Zocita on p29 instead of alone on the next page; image47 380 px and image79 58 mm tall so the unit 3 and unit 6 tests no longer carry item 6 alone onto a page; image107 400 px so unit 9's reading strand (break 43, now dropped) opens with its picture instead of a heading stack alone on a page. Sizes by height (hmm) where a width under 400 px would make the emitter pin the picture to the NEXT activity heading.
_note_midSentenceLower: The authors' find-and-replace capitalised common words inside sentences ("kuwelenga Mau ndi ziganizo", "Bwelezani Mvekelo", "ndi Kuwelenga masilabe"). Lowercased in body text only; headings keep their title case.
_note_hyphenate: No word is broken across two lines with a hyphen (user, 18 Nov: "it has hyphens at the end of the sentences"). Grade 1 readers should see every word whole. With no hyphens, justified 18pt lines opened wide gaps between words, so the body is set flush left (raggedRight), as on the Chitonga ECE LB.
_note_boxStripe: House rule for every book (QA gate); this book has no striped boxes, so nothing on the page changes.
_note_jpegQuality: Pictures stored as JPEG (quality 90, same pixels, about 300 DPI) instead of lossless: the PDF came out at 425 MB with 130 Real-ESRGAN photographs; about 62 MB this way with no visible change (user, 18 Nov: can it be reduced in size).
